## What changed

The change in a few sentences, naming the files or areas it touches.

## Why

The problem it solves, with a link to the issue or bug report.

## Verified

What you ran or observed, with before and after where behaviour changed.

## Not verified

What you did not run or could not observe. Write "nothing" only if that is true.

## Issue

<!-- Closes #<number> on a line of its own for each issue of this repository this change completes (Closes owner/repo#<number> means the same). A change with no issue says "Task: none, <reason>" on a line of its own. -->
